title.zh: Malaysia central bank launches DLT platform for tokenized bonds
title.en: Malaysia central bank launches DLT platform for tokenized bonds

current_state.zh: Bank Negara Malaysia launched SSDS+, a distributed-ledger platform for issuing, holding and transferring tokenized debt securities including sukuk, connected to the RENTAS+ system so corresponding payments settle in central bank money on a near-continuous basis.
current_state.en: Bank Negara Malaysia launched SSDS+, a distributed-ledger platform for issuing, holding and transferring tokenized debt securities including sukuk, connected to the RENTAS+ system so corresponding payments settle in central bank money on a near-continuous basis.
